title: Two things I’d like
body:
Just installed and really liking it. Subscription fee is reasonable but the one time purchase fee is a bit too much, at least in my country, which may be concerning. 

Anyway, about the app, why do I have to set a daily goal for every habit? It seems really weird to see a goal and a number on every habit or to say myself go to bed early one time daily, there should be an option to just set it done without setting number of goals every time.

Other thing I’d like the app to have is, linking chain effect for completed daily goals in calendar view. That would be motivating.

I like the simple interface, no unnecessary shiny stuff get in your way approach. If these two feature were to be added on top of that, I see myself using this app for a very long time
